title: Magical Hazard
paragraphs: “Tch! Everyone—”
“This is already the fourth time, so I won’t hold back. Paralyze Shot!”
Itsuki transformed his weapon into the shotgun he obtained in Faubrey and fired paralysis rounds. Like my Aiming Lancer, the bullets split apart and struck both the pig and the noble.
“Gwaaaaaahhhhh!?”
“While I’m at it, Air Strike Bash!”
Ren quickly closed the distance and delivered a follow-up strike to the noble’s companions.
“There’s no room for me to step in, is there?”
“If I leave it to Motoyasu-kun, you’d wipe them all out.”
Father warned me. What are you saying? They go berserk when cornered, so I’m just finishing them off.
“F-Four Holy Heroes!? What are you doing to my son?”
Father responded apologetically to the noble’s parent.
“My apologies. It seems that your son obtained a Seven Star Hero’s weapon through some means and kept it hidden. We’ve been investigating that. Please take a look at the undeniable proof before you.”
“N-No way…”
But upon seeing the floating axe, the noble’s parent seemed to understand that there was no room for excuses.
“He may be your precious son, but… he’s probably not the kind of son you can be proud of. If you dig deeper, more dirt will come out.”
“…N-Now that you mention it…”
Looks like they have an idea. Well, this troublesome task is just about finished.
“Naofumi, what’s next?”

“Killing a hero is a grave sin. Even if he stole it from someone else, the crime of not using that weapon to confront the waves as a hero is severe. Taking him into custody and having him confess would be the most peaceful solution. Also, if he truly had any intention of making the world a better place—”
“L-Like I’d ever obey the likes of you! I’m far stronger than any so-called hero—”
“Silence Shot.”
Itsuki shot the noble as if he were just finishing a chore.

“Seriously. When their true identity is revealed, they resist. When cooperation is demanded, they rebel. They always think they’re stronger than the heroes and fight back. Isn’t this getting a little too predictable?”
“Bububuu!”

And just then, a pig, seemingly trying to save its own skin, tried to scurry away, but Itsuki shot it between the eyes without hesitation. Quick draw. Ren and Itsuki have become more merciless lately. A good trend.
“W-Wait—”

Only Father had a look of shock on his face. He seemed surprised by Itsuki’s lack of hesitation when he fired. However, since they had just been discussing the common traits of such people, he pondered for a moment before nodding in understanding.
“I’ve seen enough of people like you. I could never trust someone who would abandon a loved one to curry favor with the one who defeated them.”
Is it dead? I looked at the pig. No, it’s not dead. It’s just paralyzed.
“I don’t feel any guilt about handing things over to that king anymore. It’s a dangerous sign, isn’t it?”
“Well… but at least we’ve found the Seven Star Axe, so the job is done, right?”
“…That’s true.”

“Now we just need to carefully monitor any dangerous individuals who rise to power and, if they show any suspicious behavior, strip them of their authority and put out a wanted notice. We can’t afford to waste time dealing with these kinds of people when we should be fighting the waves.”
Father and the others nodded at Ren’s words.
“After that… let’s focus on training Sakura-chan and Imiya-chan. We should also work on leveling up trustworthy people.”
“Yes, that’s true.”
“Thinking about training Imiya and Eclair is kind of refreshing. I’m starting to understand how Motoyasu feels.”
“Oh? You understand my feelings, do you? Ren, you’ve grown.”
“…That rubs me the wrong way, but fine. To continue, we don’t know who might betray us. It might be a good idea to gather trustworthy people based on Motoyasu’s memories.”
Unbelievable! I never thought the day would come when Ren and Itsuki would understand my feelings.
This means I must further advance the Filolial-sama training plan! And so, we continued sending tributes to the Pig King every day and successfully reclaimed the Seven Star Axe.
“Umm… how many has it been now?” Father asked us in a tired tone.
This was around the third month since we started this cycle.
“If I remember correctly, this would be the thirteenth person.”

We are currently at the temple where the Seven Star Weapons are enshrined. Without a rightful wielder, challengers have been coming one after another every day. Among them, there have been several instances where someone boldly proclaimed they had been chosen by the Seven Star Weapon and held it up high. However, as per Father’s advice, when I used the power to revoke ownership, the weapon would easily detach from them. Of course, since they weren’t the rightful owners, they were punished severely. Lately, when someone touches a Seven Star Weapon, it starts trembling as if resisting, making it obvious to anyone that they are not worthy.
“How many more of them are there…”
“I’m getting sick of this.”
“Same here.”
“But lately, the number has finally started to dwindle.”
“Maybe the Seven Star Weapons have learned how to resist.”
“Ah… now that you mention it, there was one suspicious challenger recently who said, ‘Huh? It won’t come out! This is strange.’”
“That’s something you’d only say if you assumed it was yours from the start.”
“Still… it’s tough that aside from the Queen of Melromarc, we’re the only ones in the world confronting the waves.”

In reality, ever since we arrived in Faubrey, waves have been occurring all over the world. For now, the nearby adventurers and knights are barely managing to suppress the waves, but they’re gradually becoming stronger. The challenge is ensuring that any wave, no matter how remote, can be dealt with.
“Sakura-chan and the others are almost at level 100, so it might be about time for them to be properly chosen by the Seven Star Weapons, right?”
“Let’s hope so. But considering how many unqualified wielders have held them so far, maybe the weapons are refusing to choose anyone.”
“Maybe… but that would be a problem.”
Indeed, in the previous cycle, Yuki-chan and the others had already leveled up enough to be chosen.
“In any case, we need to keep strengthening our forces for now.”
While we were discussing that, the temple doors flew open in a rush.
“Y-Your Excellencies, the Heroes! We have a problem!”
It looked like a soldier. He seemed to be in quite a panic.
“Did something happen?”
“Something under research at the monster laboratory went out of control, causing a magical hazard, and the Heroes are being requested to suppress the situation.”
A magical hazard? This is the first time I’ve heard that term.
“What’s a magical hazard?”
Like me, Itsuki also seemed confused as he looked at Father and the soldier.
“I don’t know either. From the way it’s phrased, I’d guess it’s some kind of magical disaster…”
“It is!”
At that moment, Rival raised her hand. Does she know what it is?
“It’s a magical disaster that humans sometimes cause. Most of the time, it’s the result of alchemy going out of control!”
“Ah… I figured it was something like that.”
“Taboos are born from failure. It’s probably an incident caused by that alchemist.”
“Rat-san? Well, she’s the type who could do something like that… but I thought she was surprisingly sincere about her research, so I figured it would be fine…”
“Still, dangerous incidents just keep happening one after another.”
“That said, we don’t have a choice but to go, right?”
“Understood!”
I’m starting to feel like we’re being used as a handyman service for solving every incident. But we have no choice but to deal with it.
“Can’t be helped.”
“I feel like there was a VR horror game with a similar title…”
“In my world, it was called Biohazard, I think.”
“Oh, they had something like that in your world too, Father? We had something similar in my world as well.”
That’s what we talked about. By the way, what exactly is a VR horror game?
